text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
"Time spent together with precious
companions!
Special yet ordinary... but truly the most
creative days ever!"

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
—And here is Tracen Academy! Our,
special yet ordinary, second asset is...
Go to the next video!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
The board game we're playing this time
is—a racing game. You move
your piece according to the numbers in
your hand. It seems simple enough—first
one to the goal wins, but—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"The obstacles set on the course, starting
positions, interactions,
the timing of when to play your trump
card... It demands strategy. Therefore—"

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
—Offense is the best defense. Spare no
cards when providing for your
subordinates.
On the honor of the Rose Clan... I shall
bring glory to our land.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"I'm not accustomed to this... Please
allow me to learn from how everyone does
things!
First, I'll observe carefully... and with
hope in my heart, await the right
opportunity."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"I calculate backward from the finish line
to schedule the path to victory.
Once that's locked in... everything else
will proceed just as planned."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
――Indeed, board games reflect an
individual's character and philosophy.
Just like racing. Which means... the move
I must make is――!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
――Genau jetzt! Everything is proceeding
according to plan.
All the cards I've held back... I will
play them right now!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
"......Tch, you still had strength left?
But I won't let you go on alone!
Advance, my piece! Bring victory to my
kingdom!"

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"I see, so the time is now. Then...
Let us connect the path we've walked so
far... and bring hope into full bloom!"

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! Just as I thought. I read you all
like a book!
From here on, it's my... wait, HUH!? ...I
can't reach anymore!?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, Flash-senpai.
Your precise card management was the
key... You have my utmost praise.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Aaaaand I'm doomed. I can't take this
anymore. Starting from the very back hurts
this much?
My strategy was supposed to be the
strongest... I mean, with this lineup—

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Man, that was one heated showdown! Felt
just as intense as a real race!
As expected of the 'greatest Derby
generation in history'♪

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
The greatest generation, each leaving
glorious hoofprints across the Umamusume
world!
No matter how you look at it, their level
is insane... Wait, where's Ruler?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I mean, isn't starting position literally
everything in this game?
It's total luck. Total RNG... *sigh*...
Whatever, I'm done.

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
"Super dark mode!
...Anyway, thanks for letting me film such
a great match♪"

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
I hope this turns out to be the wonderful
video you're looking for, Yanko-san.
"The special yet ordinary daily lives of
Umamusume" was the theme... right?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
However, does this truly satisfy the
conditions?
All we did was play... It was ordinary,
but it didn't seem particularly special.

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, that's the spirit! Everyone
gathered around
a single board and having fun... that is
precisely—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
—Yan-ko-san!
Please keep looking straight ahead!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"......All right, all fixed! The ponytail
extension was
just a little tangled up... Wait, huh?!"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, sorry for barging in!
You're... filming right now, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Buena and Desire! Right place, right
time,
and just the right duo♪ Come in, come in!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Allow me to express my gratitude for the
invitation, then...
Greetings, everyone. I am the Saint, Red
Desire.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I'm Buena Vista! Um............
............"We finally met at last"~♪

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
"...A beautiful singing voice, but why
sing?
In common society, do people sing whenever
a camera is pointed at them?"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Ah, n-not at all...! I just couldn't think
of a charming
greeting like yours, Desire-chan... It was
weird, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Please don't worry, Buena-san.
It was utterly lovely... Your singing
voice sounded just like an angel's.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"By the way... do the two of you have time
after this?
If you'd like, why don't we play a board
game together?"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Oh, thank you for the invitation.
Though I don't know very much about board
games...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"...I wonder if there are games where you
save the world?
Like becoming a holy maiden and fighting
demons...!"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Wow, that suits you perfectly,
Desire-chan!
Though I'm not very good at mind games...
Will I be okay?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"Relax. Board games cover a ridiculously
wide range.
It's settled: round two is gonna be a
party game—"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
No. Now that you're feeling better, let's
head to the course.
It's time for gate practice. Rose and I
will be helping you out.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Then, I shall accompany Buena-san and the
others...
Ruler-san, do you have any recommended
board games?

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
――Alright, here's my answer!
The item I'm bringing on an interstellar
flight is... a "recorder"!

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Even in zero gravity, ideas still pop into
your head, right?
Recording your voice makes it easy to keep
track. ...Anyone else have that idea~?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I put a "recorder" in it too.
So that no matter how far away I go, I'll
never forget those precious voices...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Let's see, in this case... since I gave
the exact same answer, do I get the
points?
Yan-ko-san, hand over those chips, please.

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Take that~! ...Wait, this is actually
super fun.
Pisa, thanks for letting me join in~.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
I just wanted Yanko-san to play along with
us, too.
...Isn't it much more fun when everyone is
in the same circle together?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Now then, next I shall reveal my answer.
The item I would bring on an interstellar
flight is... the "Holy Maiden's Stone"!
Did anyone match with me?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"......Sorry, Desire-chan! That was me!
I figured that's what you'd write,
Desire-chan... and I guessed right."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
—No way. A covering play that should
normally be impossible...
You guys look like you're worth breaking
down. Count me in for the next round.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Excuse us. Ruler-san insisted on playing
and refused
to come out of the gate... Would it be
alright if we join in as well?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
"It seems the game has only just begun.
...A fleeting, heartwarming moment. Let us
all enjoy it together."

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
"Even after clashing on the turf and
deciding victory and defeat... at the
academy,
we put our arms around each other with a
smile—best rivals and best friends."

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
This is part of our special yet ordinary
everyday life, too...
A value unique to Tracen Academy, the
youth we only have right now!
